description: Schema for a repo's ProofShot config, the file Bot 3 reads from a PR's head (proofshot.config.json). This file only documents the fields; the bot never reads it.

url.description: URL of the instance to capture, as the app under review serves it. There is no default: a repo that declares no url is skipped (skipped(no-target)), never captured on a guessed dev port, and a page that renders a login gate is refused.

seed.description: Path (relative to repo root) to a .js or .json seed file that populates localStorage before capture

captures.description: Ordered list of captures. Each capture takes a screenshot. If omitted, proofshot defaults to 2 captures (initial + loaded).

selector.description: CSS selector to scope the screenshot (omit for full-page)
